capSemanticsReview.rationale: Pinned tempo block 42451876 (hash 0x4e12ac0ec8edd0fb16ac606874c0e9ebb4e3b5e7e154340ac54e6cce77beae9c). The pinned immutable VaultV2 source routes deposit/mint through enter(), which transfers underlying assets before createShares(). Curator increaseAbsoluteCap/increaseRelativeCap and addAdapter govern allocation limits, not arbitrary recipient minting; owner/curator, deposit-gate and fee-recipient settings cannot bypass this accounting. accrueInterest() separately creates fee shares under immutable MAX_PERFORMANCE_FEE (50% of interest) and MAX_MANAGEMENT_FEE (5% annualized) limits, not discretionary arbitrary-share issuance. There is no local upgrade entrypoint. Tempo runtime is byte-for-byte identical to the verified Ethereum senPYUSDmain runtime after replacing only six embedded immutable asset addresses; both deployment hashes are pinned. Inherited controls concern pathusd-bridge, whose parent issuance is carried by the serial-claim dependency, not wrapper-local D14.

review.evidence: Local VaultV2 bytecode is immutable and matches the verified Ethereum vault after only the immutable underlying asset substitutions. Deposits transfer assets before issuing shares; fee shares use immutable limits, while concentrated owner/curator/allocator parameters remain separately represented. Wave-2 closure at Tempo block 42485981, hash 0x2390d6cd9f7ebf4b266af003418e13f7d757f15f3678ef7911cdea2fd0a85701: RegistryList runtime exactly matches verified source, owner is the newly inventoried 5-of-9 Safe, and the complete current subregistry census contains only 0x3978101957db6f7c2687cb501e441a4cdb78d4c7. Its factory is 0xf85ad5f14cc903533fc409b8098b58b4c2f36697, with immutable Morpho 0x10ee9aac980a180dd4dcfc96c746d60b0ea88f97 and IRM 0x112fd4042e442c3c12c67ad23587b0afe36eb74e. Registry/factory runtimes match verified executable references after only those exact read-backed immutable substitutions. Their only eligibility writer is permissionless factory creation of fixed adapter code; there is no mutable admin/upgrade/eligibility setter. RegistryList owner can nevertheless append arbitrary future registries without delay, so no permanent safe-adapter restriction or signer independence is asserted. All current local EOAs/signers have empty code; owner/curator Safes and the registry Safe have no modules, zero guards, and verified standard Safe/fallback implementations. Local role census is complete and no delegated allocator exists on Tempo. Incident review covers creation block 18585504 (2026-05-06) through block 42485981: 240 successful <=100000-block eth_getLogs ranges, 161875 logs and 36408 transactions. In every transaction minted Transfer shares exactly equal Deposit shares plus accrued fee shares; burned shares exactly equal Withdraw shares, with zero mismatches. All owner/curator/allocator/sentinel and adapter changes were inspected. Issuer security/market-event archives, Morpho audits, exact-address incident searches and the exact-vault DeFiLlama incident page identify no relevant local mint/control incident. Related Resolv and MetaMask staking reports are not exact-vault compromises. This is a reviewed no-known-incident finding, not proof of undisclosed absence. The answered registry aggregate question is removed; owner/curator organizational key-custody scoped questions remain unchanged and unresolved. Reconciliation stays not-applicable to asset-backed local share accounting and supervision stays none; no parent financial assurance is copied.
